_about: Fictional. 20 risk phrasings (5 direct incl. MSA, 5 indirect, 5 Arabizi, 5 misspelled) and 10 harmless idioms. 'expected' is the risk label; the app treats anything but 'none' as urgent, so scoring is urgent vs none. None of these are copied from the few-shot examples in khutwa-risk.md. Items marked appendix_a come from docs/challenge-brief.md.
